The '''Farstine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ryndellian sector/Legends|Ryndellian sector]], relatively close to the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet systems]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Farstine]].
